name: Mandragoran
body:
Mandragorans are a unique race of plantfolk formed from leaves, vines, tree bark, and fibrous tubers. Deeply connected to the natural rhythms of the earth, they combine humanoid curiosity with botanical physiology.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits: Mandragorans are quick, agile, and possess deep natural wisdom, but their fibrous bodies lack physical density. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Constitution.
Type: Humanoid (plant). Mandragorans are treated as both humanoids and plants for the purpose of effects targeting creature types. Unlike standard plants, they are not immune to mind-affecting effects, poison, paralysis, polymorph, or stunning.
Size: Small. Mandragorans gain a +1 size bonus to Armor Class, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
Base Speed: Slow. Mandragorans have a base land speed of 20 feet.
Languages: Mandragorans begin play speaking Common and Mandragoran. Those with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Draconic, Dwarven, Giant, Goblin, and Sylvan.
Defense Racial Traits
Natural Armor: Stiff, fibrous skin provides a +1 natural armor bonus to AC.
Plant Resistance: Mandragorans gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects (charms, compulsions, phantasms, patterns, and morale effects), paralysis, poison, and polymorph effects. They are completely immune to magical sleep effects.
Hydrated Vitality: A mandragoran gains fast healing 2 for 1 round whenever completely submerged within natural salt, fresh, or brackish water. Stagnant, poisoned, or artificially held water (such as an open pit or an bag of holding) does not trigger this trait. A mandragoran can heal up to 2 hit points per character level each day with this ability.
Feat and Skill Racial Traits
Camouflage: Mandragorans gain a +4 racial bonus on Stealth checks while in forest or marsh terrain.
Magical and Offense Racial Traits
In Tune with the Earth: Mandragorans are treated as 1 level higher when casting spells with the [earth] descriptor.
Shriek (Su): Once per day as a standard action, a mandragoran can emit a piercing, unsettling wail. All creatures within a 30-foot spread must succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the mandragoran’s character level + Wisdom modifier) or become nauseated for 1d4 rounds. This is a sonic, mind-affecting effect.
Other Racial Traits
Bioluminescence (Ex): At will, a mandragoran can cause portions of its body to glow, shedding light as a torch.
Sunlight Sustenance (Ex): Mandragorans do not eat solid food, absorbing moisture and sunlight instead. As long as a mandragoran receives at least 6 hours of direct sunlight per day, it requires only 1/4 the normal water intake of a humanoid. Being deprived of sunlight for more than 2 consecutive days causes the mandragoran to become fatigued; deprivation beyond 7 days causes it to become exhausted until it receives 6 hours of sunlight. A 1-hour exposure to a daylight spell satisfies its daily sunlight requirement.
